title: GitLab
description: Whether GitLab answers, then where its time goes: Rails and Puma, Sidekiq, Git and the bundled datastores. Callers come from the Rails request log, CI job pods from the kubelet.

links.title: Fleet overview
links.tooltip: Start page: every host, service and signal at a glance

list.name: Argo CD syncs
list.expr: (sum by (name, phase) (increase(argocd_app_sync_total{dry_run="false",name!~".+-mr-[0-9]+"}[2m])) > 0 unless on (name) sum by (name) (increase(argocd_app_sync_total{dry_run="false"}[1h])) > 6) and on () vector($syncs) > 0

list.name: Host rebuilds
list.expr: (max by (host_name, revision) (sysconf_installed_commit_time_seconds) unless max by (host_name, revision) (sysconf_installed_commit_time_seconds offset 15m)) and on () vector($rebuilds) > 0

list.name: level
list.label: Level
list.description: Lowest severity of the log lines to show.

list.name: search
list.label: Search
list.description: Text that the log lines must contain, for example a user name, a project path or a correlation id. Empty shows every line.

list.name: syncs
list.label: Argo CD syncs
list.description: Marks each Argo CD sync on the time series.

list.name: rebuilds
list.label: Host rebuilds
list.description: Marks each NixOS rebuild on the time series.

panels.description: Whether the probe got an answer below 400 from https://gitlab.bjoernblessin.de in the last five minutes.
Share of Rails requests answered 5xx. Workhorse answers git and uploads on its own and stays out.
95th percentile duration of a Rails request.
Requests queued for a Puma thread. Above zero every thread is busy.
Age of the oldest job across the Sidekiq queues.
Gitaly calls per second that ended in Internal, Unavailable or DeadlineExceeded. NotFound and Canceled stay out as routine.
Whether postgres_exporter reaches the bundled database. Down can also mean the exporter lost its connection.
Whether redis_exporter reaches the bundled Redis, which holds the Sidekiq queues.
Sidekiq processes running. Zero with the pod running means that runit lost Sidekiq.
Jobs waiting on a backoff. A steady climb means one job keeps failing.
Jobs that used up every retry. They stay until someone retries or deletes them in the admin area.
Container restarts of GitLab over the selected range. GitLab runs in one pod, so a restart takes the whole instance down.

panels.title: Requests by status
panels.description: Rails requests per second by status class.

panels.title: Request latency
panels.description: Duration of a Rails request, and the time it waited between Workhorse and Rails. The wait rises before the duration does when Puma runs out of threads.

panels.title: Puma threads
panels.description: Threads that Puma can hand out, threads busy with a request, and requests waiting for one. Waiting above zero calls for more Puma workers.

panels.title: Oldest job by queue
panels.description: Age of the oldest waiting job per queue. A deep queue that drains fast stays low here.

panels.title: Queue depth
panels.description: Jobs waiting per queue.

panels.title: Jobs
panels.description: Jobs per second that Sidekiq finished, and jobs that raised. A raised job goes to the retry queue.

panels.title: Gitaly calls by method
panels.description: Ten busiest Gitaly methods. Every git read and write reaches the repositories through one of them.

panels.title: Gitaly calls not OK
panels.description: Gitaly calls per second by result code other than OK. NotFound follows probes against a missing ref. Internal and Unavailable point at the repositories or Gitaly itself.

panels.title: Workhorse
panels.description: Requests per second through Workhorse by status code, with the git clones and fetches open. Every request enters here, git over HTTP, uploads and artifacts included.

panels.title: Postgres connections by state
panels.description: Connections to the bundled database. idle in transaction climbing while active stays flat points at a transaction that someone holds open.

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: Size per database. The database shares its volume with the repositories.

panels.title: Redis memory and SQL time
panels.description: Memory that Redis holds, and the 95th percentile duration of a SQL query from Rails and Sidekiq.

panels.title: CPU by pod
panels.description: CPU cores in use per pod against its limit. At the limit the kernel throttles the pod.

panels.title: Memory by pod
panels.description: Working set per pod against its limit. A container that reaches the limit gets killed.

panels.title: Restarts by container
panels.description: Container restarts per interval. A restart of a single-replica service drops every open connection.

panels.title: Callers
panels.description: API and browser requests to Rails by user, address and client software, busiest first. A runner asking for jobs signs in with its runner token and shows no user. Select a user to see their log lines.

targets.expr: k8s.namespace.name:=gitlab k8s.container.name:=gitlab "\"meta.caller_id\":" "\"duration_s\":" | unpack_json fields (username, status, duration_s, ua, route, path, method, meta.remote_ip, meta.caller_id, meta.project, meta.client_type) | filter meta.client_type:in(api, browser) | stats by (username, meta.remote_ip, ua) count() requests, count() if (status:>=400) errors, quantile(0.95, duration_s) p95 | sort by (requests desc) | limit 100

panels.title: Busiest routes
panels.description: Rails routes and pages by requests, with their 5xx count and 95th percentile duration.

targets.expr: k8s.namespace.name:=gitlab k8s.container.name:=gitlab "\"meta.caller_id\":" "\"duration_s\":" | unpack_json fields (username, status, duration_s, ua, route, path, method, meta.remote_ip, meta.caller_id, meta.project, meta.client_type) | filter meta.client_type:in(api, browser) | stats by (meta.caller_id) count() requests, count() if (status:>=500) errors, quantile(0.95, duration_s) p95 | sort by (requests desc) | limit 100

panels.title: Projects
panels.description: Requests per project, from API calls, pages and CI. Select a project to see its log lines.

targets.expr: k8s.namespace.name:=gitlab k8s.container.name:=gitlab "\"meta.caller_id\":" "\"duration_s\":" | unpack_json fields (username, status, duration_s, ua, route, path, method, meta.remote_ip, meta.caller_id, meta.project, meta.client_type) | filter meta.client_type:in(api, browser) meta.project:* | stats by (meta.project) count() requests, count_uniq(username) users, count() if (status:>=400) errors | sort by (requests desc) | limit 50

panels.title: CI job pods
panels.description: Job pods of the runner over the selected range, with their CPU peak. The pod name carries the project id.

panels.title: GitLab and runner lines
panels.description: Every Omnibus service and the runner, interleaved, newest first. Level and Search narrow it.

targets.expr: k8s.namespace.name:in(gitlab, gitlab-runner) severity_number:$level _msg:~"$search" | copy severity_text as level
